FORM.notes: source note: 此處Vaw完整應為Yavaw。

S.FORM: ti' kuing ga kainu' kung na hawving hawving na vaw.
S.PHON: tiʔ kuiŋ ɣa kainuʔ kuŋ na ħaw*iŋ ħaw*iŋ na *aw
S.FORM: ti' kuing ga kainu' kung na hawving hawving na vaw.
S.PHON: tiʔ kuiŋ ɣa kainuʔ kuŋ na ħaw*iŋ ħaw*iŋ na *aw
S.TRANSL: 我是Kainu',Hawvin的兒子,Hawvin是Vaw的兒子.
I am Kainu', son of Hawvin, son of Vaw.

FORM.notes: source note: 汶水泰雅不同村之間有b/v, c/s等發音上的差異。清安村發音人較年輕一輩的詞彙已無b和c的音，但較年長的發音人的部分詞彙仍保留b和c的音。此篇語料係依照發音人的發音而給予標記。

S.FORM: sunga' su' musa' kuing i sumvu' su ngarux.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ [s|ɕ]uʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ kuiŋ i [s|ɕ]um*uʔ [s|ɕ]u ŋarux
S.FORM: sunga' su' musa' kuing i sumvu' su ngarux.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ [s|ɕ]uʔ mu[s|ɕ]aʔ kuiŋ i [s|ɕ]um*uʔ [s|ɕ]u ŋarux
S.TRANSL: 我以前會去獵熊.
In the past, I went to shoot bears.

S.FORM: anananu' ga ginalganmu i musa i sumvu su vawwak i lahulahu sunga'.
S.PHON: anananuʔ ɣa ɣinalɣanmu i mu[s|ɕ]a i [s|ɕ]um*u [s|ɕ]u *awwak i laħulaħu [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.FORM: anananu' ga ginalganmu i musa i sumvu su vawwak i lahulahu sunga'.
S.PHON: anananuʔ ɣa ɣinalɣanmu i mu[s|ɕ]a i [s|ɕ]um*u [s|ɕ]u *awwak i laħulaħu [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.TRANSL: 以前我都有跟隨(人們)去森林裡射野豬.
In the past, I followed (people) to the forest to shoot boars all the time.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處書可能指地圖或文字。itaal專指泰雅族人。

S.FORM: musa' kuing ru gi vali kia viru' na itaal sunga'.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ kuiŋ ru ɣi *ali kia *iruʔ na itaal [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.FORM: musa' kuing ru gi vali kia viru' na itaal sunga'.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ kuiŋ ru ɣi *ali kia *iruʔ na itaal [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.TRANSL: 我去(那裏)因為以前沒有我們的書.
I went (there), because there were no books of us in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: 此處asi亦有直接的意思。

S.FORM: musa' ragiax ga mutux asi hakay ru.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ raɣiax ɣa mutux a[s|ɕ]i ħakaj ru
S.FORM: musa' ragiax ga mutux asi hakay ru.
S.PHON: mu[s|ɕ]aʔ raɣiax ɣa mutux a[s|ɕ]i ħakaj ru
S.TRANSL: 如果我去山上,我會只用走的去.
When I went to the mountain, I would just go on foot.

S.FORM: yumiax i sa qutux su ragiax la ga.
S.PHON: jumiax i [s|ɕ]a qutux [s|ɕ]u raɣiax la ɣa
S.FORM: yumiax i sa qutux su ragiax la ga.
S.PHON: jumiax i [s|ɕ]a qutux [s|ɕ]u raɣiax la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 我從一(座山上)走下來.
I went down from a (mountain).

FORM.notes: source note: inuwah來過；inuwah表示來的路。

S.FORM: ini' vaqi ku inuwahan.
S.PHON: iniʔ *aqi ku inuwaħan
S.FORM: ini' vaqi ku inuwahan.
S.PHON: iniʔ *aqi ku inuwaħan
S.TRANSL: (我)不知道走過的路.
(I) didn't know the road traveled.

FORM.notes: source note: asi語意上修飾其後的動詞，單獨使用時根據語境有「只能」、「只有」等語意。和特定的功能詞使用時則修飾其後的命題，有「必要」（asi ki）、「好像」（asi ga）等語意。目前將此類用法合併為一個單位標記。

S.FORM: ini' vaqi i ku inuwahan la ga asiki kutan ku kahuniq gi naki vaqun ku inuwahan ru'.
S.PHON: iniʔ *aqi i ku inuwaħan la ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki kutan ku kaħuniq ɣi naki *aqun ku inuwaħan ruʔ
S.FORM: ini' vaqi i ku inuwahan la ga asiki kutan ku kahuniq gi naki vaqun ku inuwahan ru'.
S.PHON: iniʔ *aqi i ku inuwaħan la ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki kutan ku kaħuniq ɣi naki *aqun ku inuwaħan ruʔ
S.TRANSL: 如果不知道來的路,就必須要砍樹,這樣才會知道來的路.
If (you) did not know the road traveled, (you) needed to chop down the trees, so that you would know the road traveled.

S.FORM: naki ini' i putukari'.
S.PHON: naki iniʔ i putukariʔ
S.FORM: naki ini' i putukari'.
S.PHON: naki iniʔ i putukariʔ
S.TRANSL: 你才不會迷路.
This way you wouldn't get lost.

S.FORM: mutukari'su' la ga pasiquawsu' inu' ga qatsu' vavaqun.
S.PHON: mutukariʔ[s|ɕ]uʔ la ɣa pa[s|ɕ]iquaw[s|ɕ]uʔ inuʔ ɣa qat[s|ɕ]uʔ *a*aqun
S.FORM: mutukari'su' la ga pasiquawsu' inu' ga qatsu' vavaqun.
S.PHON: mutukariʔ[s|ɕ]uʔ la ɣa pa[s|ɕ]iquaw[s|ɕ]uʔ inuʔ ɣa qat[s|ɕ]uʔ *a*aqun
S.TRANSL: 如果你迷路的話,你不知道你會在哪裡出現.
If you get lost, you don't know where you will appear.

S.FORM: qatsu' laluwan na squliq musa' kumiyum.
S.PHON: qat[s|ɕ]uʔ laluwan na [s|ɕ]quliq mu[s|ɕ]aʔ kumijum
S.FORM: qatsu' laluwan na squliq musa' kumiyum.
S.PHON: qat[s|ɕ]uʔ laluwan na [s|ɕ]quliq mu[s|ɕ]aʔ kumijum
S.TRANSL: 你不會被搜尋的人找到.
You wouldn't be found by people who go for a search.

FORM.notes: source note: 目前不確定a 'usa是否與前個IU為同一clause。

S.FORM: ru' nanu' tiku kai'mu sawni' ka maha u asiki kutan tikay ku kahuniq gi naki vaqun su ku a 'usa.
S.PHON: ruʔ nanuʔ tiku kaiʔmu [s|ɕ]awniʔ ka maħa u a[s|ɕ]iki kutan tikaj ku kaħuniq ɣi naki *aqun [s|ɕ]u ku a ʔu[s|ɕ]a
S.FORM: ru' nanu' tiku kai'mu sawni' ka maha u asiki kutan tikay ku kahuniq gi naki vaqun su ku a 'usa.
S.PHON: ruʔ nanuʔ tiku kaiʔmu [s|ɕ]awniʔ ka maħa u a[s|ɕ]iki kutan tikaj ku kaħuniq ɣi naki *aqun [s|ɕ]u ku a ʔu[s|ɕ]a
S.TRANSL: (像)我剛才說的,必須要砍一點樹才會知道要走哪裡.
(Like) what I just said, it's necessary to chop a little wood so that you know where to go.

FORM.notes: source note: ini' ga意為「或者」。

S.FORM: ru musa' i i sumvu' su yapit ini' ga vawwak sunga' ga.
S.PHON: ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i i [s|ɕ]um*uʔ [s|ɕ]u japit iniʔ ɣa *awwak [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa
S.FORM: ru musa' i i sumvu' su yapit ini' ga vawwak sunga' ga.
S.PHON: ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i i [s|ɕ]um*uʔ [s|ɕ]u japit iniʔ ɣa *awwak [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa
S.TRANSL: 我以前去射飛鼠或山豬
I went to shoot polatouches or boars in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: vay為suvalay簡稱。

S.FORM: mutux i payux vay ku qasinu sunga' gi nanu' gi uwehti' ku lahulahu.
S.PHON: mutux i pajux *aj ku qa[s|ɕ]inu [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣi nanuʔ ɣi uweħtiʔ ku laħulaħu
S.FORM: mutux i payux vay ku qasinu sunga' gi nanu' gi uwehti' ku lahulahu.
S.PHON: mutux i pajux *aj ku qa[s|ɕ]inu [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣi nanuʔ ɣi uweħtiʔ ku laħulaħu
S.TRANSL: 以前真的會有很多野獸,因為森林很寬廣.
There would really be many beasts in the past, because the forest was widespread.

FORM.notes: source note: anananu任何東西。

S.FORM: ru anananu' ga kia.
S.PHON: ru anananuʔ ɣa kia
S.FORM: ru anananu' ga kia.
S.PHON: ru anananuʔ ɣa kia
S.TRANSL: 什麼東西都有.
There was everything.

FORM.notes: source note: kavahniq(單數)。

S.FORM: ngarux ru miit para ru kakavahniq ga.
S.PHON: ŋarux ru miit para ru kaka*aħniq ɣa
S.FORM: ngarux ru miit para ru kakavahniq ga.
S.PHON: ŋarux ru miit para ru kaka*aħniq ɣa
S.TRANSL: 像是有熊、山羊、山羌、還有鳥.
Like bears, goats, muntjacs, and birds.

S.FORM: mutux i alun na nku nku navakis halan naha' sumvu'.
S.PHON: mutux i alun na nku nku na*aki[s|ɕ] ħalan naħaʔ [s|ɕ]um*uʔ
S.FORM: mutux i alun na nku nku navakis halan naha' sumvu'.
S.PHON: mutux i alun na nku nku na*aki[s|ɕ] ħalan naħaʔ [s|ɕ]um*uʔ
S.TRANSL: 老人會去打獵,把(獵物)拿回來.
Old men would go shooting and take (the prey) back.

S.FORM: vuun naha' ru nanu' a mutux naha' sipanga ru rasun naha' imuag.
S.PHON: *uun naħaʔ ru nanuʔ a mutux naħaʔ [s|ɕ]ipaŋa ru ra[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ imuaɣ
S.FORM: vuun naha' ru nanu' a mutux naha' sipanga ru rasun naha' imuag.
S.PHON: *uun naħaʔ ru nanuʔ a mutux naħaʔ [s|ɕ]ipaŋa ru ra[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ imuaɣ
S.TRANSL: 他們去打獵,會把(獵物)用背的帶回家.
They went shooting, and would bear (the prey) on their back home.

S.FORM: gi raranga' naha' cku qutuxnia' su'imuag gi.
S.PHON: ɣi raraŋaʔ naħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ku qutuxniaʔ [s|ɕ]uʔimuaɣ ɣi
S.FORM: gi raranga' naha' cku qutuxnia' su'imuag gi.
S.PHON: ɣi raraŋaʔ naħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ku qutuxniaʔ [s|ɕ]uʔimuaɣ ɣi
S.TRANSL: 他們要紓解一家人.
They will relieve his family.

S.FORM: ukas ku naniqun naha' sunga'.
S.PHON: uka[s|ɕ] ku naniqun naħaʔ [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.FORM: ukas ku naniqun naha' sunga'.
S.PHON: uka[s|ɕ] ku naniqun naħaʔ [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ
S.TRANSL: 因為他們過去沒有什麼東西吃.
That's because they have little to eat in the past.

S.FORM: i vali kia ku slaq ka patuwawun naha'.
S.PHON: i *ali kia ku [s|ɕ]laq ka patuwawun naħaʔ
S.FORM: i vali kia ku slaq ka patuwawun naha'.
S.PHON: i *ali kia ku [s|ɕ]laq ka patuwawun naħaʔ
S.TRANSL: 沒有農田讓他們耕作.
There was no farming field for them to farm.

FORM.notes: source note: pintuawan收成。 | source note: pati'和vuax相同。

S.FORM: asi qaniq su qaqasinu gi ukas ku' pintuawan naha' ka nanu pati' ru vuax.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]i qaniq [s|ɕ]u qaqa[s|ɕ]inu ɣi uka[s|ɕ] kuʔ pintuawan naħaʔ ka nanu patiʔ ru *uax
S.FORM: asi qaniq su qaqasinu gi ukas ku' pintuawan naha' ka nanu pati' ru vuax.
S.PHON: a[s|ɕ]i qaniq [s|ɕ]u qaqa[s|ɕ]inu ɣi uka[s|ɕ] kuʔ pintuawan naħaʔ ka nanu patiʔ ru *uax
S.TRANSL: 他們只有吃獸肉因為沒有米的收成.
They could only eat beasts because there was no harvest of rice.

S.FORM: ru yaku qasinu ku niqun naha'.
S.PHON: ru jaku qa[s|ɕ]inu ku niqun naħaʔ
S.FORM: ru yaku qasinu ku niqun naha'.
S.PHON: ru jaku qa[s|ɕ]inu ku niqun naħaʔ
S.TRANSL: 他們吃那個野獸.
They ate that beast.

FORM.notes: source note: atu' 原意為”界線”，與連詞na合用有”如果…真的”的語意。

S.FORM: ru' atu' na sumvu' ga rasun imuag rasun imuag ru.
S.PHON: ruʔ atuʔ na [s|ɕ]um*uʔ ɣa ra[s|ɕ]un imuaɣ ra[s|ɕ]un imuaɣ ru
S.FORM: ru' atu' na sumvu' ga rasun imuag rasun imuag ru.
S.PHON: ruʔ atuʔ na [s|ɕ]um*uʔ ɣa ra[s|ɕ]un imuaɣ ra[s|ɕ]un imuaɣ ru
S.TRANSL: 如果射獵完,(他們)把獵物帶回家.
If after shooting, they bring back to house.

FORM.notes: source note: nial表示「正在」，為hanial簡稱，與hanian(正在)為不同方言說法，不確定是否為progressive。

S.FORM: nial numaga' imuag ku kakanayril.
S.PHON: nial numaɣaʔ imuaɣ ku kakanajril
S.FORM: nial numaga' imuag ku kakanayril.
S.PHON: nial numaɣaʔ imuaɣ ku kakanajril
S.TRANSL: 女人在家裡等.
Women were waiting in the house.

S.FORM: atu' na parux ku sinvu' ga nanu' u sitaku sikal sikaal cku a 'ulaqi' maha halayta' i mapanga gi.
S.PHON: atuʔ na parux ku [s|ɕ]in*uʔ ɣa nanuʔ u [s|ɕ]itaku [s|ɕ]ikal [s|ɕ]ikaal [ʦ|ʨ]ku a ʔulaqiʔ maħa ħalajtaʔ i mapaŋa ɣi
S.FORM: atu' na parux ku sinvu' ga nanu' u sitaku sikal sikaal cku a 'ulaqi' maha halayta' i mapanga gi.
S.PHON: atuʔ na parux ku [s|ɕ]in*uʔ ɣa nanuʔ u [s|ɕ]itaku [s|ɕ]ikal [s|ɕ]ikaal [ʦ|ʨ]ku a ʔulaqiʔ maħa ħalajtaʔ i mapaŋa ɣi
S.TRANSL: 如果他們射到許多,會告訴小孩,＂我們去背回來＂.
If they shot much, they would tell the kids, "Let's go to bring back".

FORM.notes: source note: ini' vaqi表示「無法」。saxa'一人(人數有專門數法)。

S.FORM: ini' vaqi mapanga' na saxa' gi payux ga.
S.PHON: iniʔ *aqi mapaŋaʔ na [s|ɕ]axaʔ ɣi pajux ɣa
S.FORM: ini' vaqi mapanga' na saxa' gi payux ga.
S.PHON: iniʔ *aqi mapaŋaʔ na [s|ɕ]axaʔ ɣi pajux ɣa
S.TRANSL: 一個人搬不動,因為太多.
One man can't bear it, because it's too much.

FORM.notes: source note: sinsining為日語外來語。

S.FORM: ru nanu' rasun ku sinsining ru maha halayta' i magal ku sinvu'mu.
S.PHON: ru nanuʔ ra[s|ɕ]un ku [s|ɕ]in[s|ɕ]iniŋ ru maħa ħalajtaʔ i maɣal ku [s|ɕ]in*uʔmu
S.FORM: ru nanu' rasun ku sinsining ru maha halayta' i magal ku sinvu'mu.
S.PHON: ru nanuʔ ra[s|ɕ]un ku [s|ɕ]in[s|ɕ]iniŋ ru maħa ħalajtaʔ i maɣal ku [s|ɕ]in*uʔmu
S.TRANSL: 他們帶年輕人,說＂我們去拿回我射的獵物＂.
They led the youngster, saying "Let's go bring back the prey I hunted'.

S.FORM: gi parux ku sinvu' nanu rasun rasun ku sinsining ru.
S.PHON: ɣi parux ku [s|ɕ]in*uʔ nanu ra[s|ɕ]un ra[s|ɕ]un ku [s|ɕ]in[s|ɕ]iniŋ ru
S.FORM: gi parux ku sinvu' nanu rasun rasun ku sinsining ru.
S.PHON: ɣi parux ku [s|ɕ]in*uʔ nanu ra[s|ɕ]un ra[s|ɕ]un ku [s|ɕ]in[s|ɕ]iniŋ ru
S.TRANSL: 因為有太多要拿回來,所以(他們)帶年輕人.
Because there was too much to bring back, (they) brought the youngsters.

S.FORM: sipanga' naha' ru rasun naha' imuag.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]ipaŋaʔ naħaʔ ru ra[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ imuaɣ
S.FORM: sipanga' naha' ru rasun naha' imuag.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]ipaŋaʔ naħaʔ ru ra[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ imuaɣ
S.TRANSL: 他們背在身上帶回家.
They bore it on back and brought it home.

S.FORM: rasun naha' imuaug ru talan kahavaw.
S.PHON: ra[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ imuauɣ ru talan kaħa*aw
S.FORM: rasun naha' imuaug ru talan kahavaw.
S.PHON: ra[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ imuauɣ ru talan kaħa*aw
S.TRANSL: 他們帶回家,所有人都看到.
They brought it back home and everyone saw them.

S.FORM: nial imuaug ga paqasun naha' ru.
S.PHON: nial imuauɣ ɣa paqa[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ ru
S.FORM: nial imuaug ga paqasun naha' ru.
S.PHON: nial imuauɣ ɣa paqa[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ ru
S.TRANSL: 家人很開心.
The family were happy.

FORM.notes: source note: numage有「準備」的意思。

S.FORM: numaga' gi i panuvuwaw su quaw.
S.PHON: numaɣaʔ ɣi i panu*uwaw [s|ɕ]u quaw
S.FORM: numaga' gi i panuvuwaw su quaw.
S.PHON: numaɣaʔ ɣi i panu*uwaw [s|ɕ]u quaw
S.TRANSL: (他們)準備酒喝.
(They) prepared wine for drinking.

S.FORM: manuvuaw su quaw la ru nanu' gi paqasun naha' la ga.
S.PHON: manu*uaw [s|ɕ]u quaw la ru nanuʔ ɣi paqa[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ la ɣa
S.FORM: manuvuaw su quaw la ru nanu' gi paqasun naha' la ga.
S.PHON: manu*uaw [s|ɕ]u quaw la ru nanuʔ ɣi paqa[s|ɕ]un naħaʔ la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 喝完酒之後,他們很開心.
After they drank wine, they got happy.

S.FORM: elev panyugi' la.
S.PHON: ele* panjuɣiʔ la
S.FORM: elev panyugi' la.
S.PHON: ele* panjuɣiʔ la
S.TRANSL: (他們)跳舞.
(They) dance.

S.FORM: ru niqun naha' ku tahkun naha' ku inaras ru niqun naha'.
S.PHON: ru niqun naħaʔ ku taħkun naħaʔ ku inara[s|ɕ] ru niqun naħaʔ
S.FORM: ru niqun naha' ku tahkun naha' ku inaras ru niqun naha'.
S.PHON: ru niqun naħaʔ ku taħkun naħaʔ ku inara[s|ɕ] ru niqun naħaʔ
S.TRANSL: 他們就吃,烹煮和享用帶回來的東西.
They ate, and cooked and ate the thing they brought back.

FORM.notes: source note: sua可能為語誤。

S.FORM: sua' ana ku 'ulaqi' uwi ga.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]uaʔ ana ku ʔulaqiʔ uwi ɣa
S.FORM: sua' ana ku 'ulaqi' uwi ga.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]uaʔ ana ku ʔulaqiʔ uwi ɣa
S.TRANSL: 連小孩也(來吃).
Even children (ate), too.

FORM.notes: source note: salun意為「名稱」。

S.FORM: ini' i qavaq i sasalun qasinu ga.
S.PHON: iniʔ i qa*aq i [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]alun qa[s|ɕ]inu ɣa
S.FORM: ini' i qavaq i sasalun qasinu ga.
S.PHON: iniʔ i qa*aq i [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]alun qa[s|ɕ]inu ɣa
S.TRANSL: (小孩)不知道野獸的名稱.
(The children) didn't know the names of the beasts.

S.FORM: sahahiya' naha' niqun gi qaat u minaniq su nak minukahul i lahulahu.

S.TRANSL: 他們所吃的東西很美味,因為他們沒吃過來自森林的東西.
What they ate was delicious. That's because they had never eaten things from the forest.

S.TRANSL: 至於現在的生活,如果有一點錢,我們會去(做某事).
As for the life now, if with a little money, we would (do something).

(We) go the Han people's village to buy meat.
